simulation_assumptions.name: simulated-gimbal-imu-drive-feedback-v1
simulation_assumptions.filter: VQF 2.1.2 online VQF; uses only accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer
simulation_assumptions.acceleration_semantics: proper acceleration in sensor body frame, m/s^2; zero is valid free-fall data
simulation_assumptions.magnetometer_semantics: raw signed counts divided by 32768 for storage/VQF; no uT calibration evidence
simulation_assumptions.sensor_mount_assumption: IMU axes aligned with pitch_link; no mount rotation or bias calibration available
simulation_assumptions.gimbal_kinematics: R_body_sensor = Rz(yaw) * Ry(-pitch); pitch joint positive direction is local -Y
simulation_assumptions.attitude_source_simulation: VQF 2.1.2 estimated from noisy accel/gyro/magnetometer only
simulation_assumptions.attitude_source_hardware: ATK-IMU901 firmware quaternion is passed through; Euler remains diagnostic-only
simulation_assumptions.temperature_semantics: decoded for diagnostics only; excluded from the policy vector and VQF fusion
simulation_assumptions.motor_iq_semantics: simulation equivalent Iq only when supplied by the explicit actuator-effort model; assumed Kt=0.035 Nm/A and efficiency=1, uncalibrated and not measured current

feedback.missing_or_expired: group values are zero and its valid flag is zero; age is bounded

estimated_pose.position_source: simulated UWB position measurement from plant pose plus Gaussian noise
estimated_pose.sampling: one independent measurement per unique FieldTask.time using a dedicated episode-seeded RNG
estimated_pose.heading_source: feedback attitude with measured gimbal inverse kinematics; zero when invalid
estimated_pose.gimbal_source: feedback measured joint positions; zero when invalid
